brief: Make a website for Riverside Run 2027, a city running event in Pune. Runners should be able to compare the three races, work out what they will pay with a fee calculator, register with a form, see the race-day and expo-day schedule, see the route and water stations for each race, read FAQs, and see sponsors by tier. Volunteers should be able to sign up with a separate form. Add a countdown to race day, a menu that stays on screen and shows which section you are in, and a high-contrast mode that works across the whole page. It should feel sporty and clear and work well on phones.
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send these: What are the race day and expo day dates, and what is the schedule for each day (for example gates open, each race start time, expo opening and closing)? Also, where is the start and finish, and the expo venue; What are the three races called, how long is each, and what does each cost to enter; What should the fee calculator take into account? For example early-bird price, student or age discounts, group discounts, a t-shirt or medal add-on, or a payment fee. Please share the amounts too; Can you share the details for the route and water stations of each race, the sponsor names by tier (for example title, gold, silver), and the questions and answers for the FAQ? Also, what phone number, email or social links should show on the site, and where should the registration and volunteer forms be sent.
questions_to_user.answer: Race day: Sunday 14 February 2027. Expo day: Saturday 13 February 2027, 10am to 6pm, at Riverside Grounds, 5 River Road, Pune 411001. Races: 5K (start 7:30am, fee Rs 300, minimum age 12, cutoff 1 hour); 10K (start 6:45am, fee Rs 500, minimum age 16, cutoff 2 hours); Half Marathon (start 6:00am, fee Rs 800, minimum age 18, cutoff 3 hours 30 minutes). Event T-shirt: Rs 250 each, optional. Early-bird: 10% off race fees only (not T-shirts) for registrations up to 31 December 2026. Fee calculator: choose race, number of runners (1 to 10) and number of T-shirts; show the total. Water stations: 5K at 2.5 km; 10K at 2.5, 5 and 7.5 km; Half Marathon every 3 km. Use a placeholder for each route map. Registration form: name, email, phone, date of birth, race (dropdown), T-shirt yes/no, T-shirt size (only shown if T-shirt is yes), emergency contact name and phone, guardian name (only required if the runner is under 18); sends to run@example.com. Volunteer form: name, email, preferred role (Water station, Registration desk, Route marshal), available Saturday / Sunday / both; sends to volunteers@example.com. Schedule: Expo day 10am bib collection opens, 4pm route briefing, 6pm expo closes. Race day 5:00am gates open, 6:00am Half Marathon, 6:45am 10K, 7:30am 5K, 10:00am prize ceremony. FAQs: Can I change my race? Yes, until 31 January 2027 by email. Is there parking? Yes, free at Gate 2. Are refunds available? No. Where do I collect my bib? At the expo on 13 February. Is there a bag drop? Yes, near the start line. Are pacers provided? Yes, for the 10K and Half Marathon. Sponsors: Gold: Meridian Bank; Silver: Trailhead Sports, Aqua Pure; Community: Pune Runners Club. Contact: run@example.com, WhatsApp +91 00000 44444. No photos yet, use placeholders.
